title: Absent Heroes/Quotes
summary:
"I swear, I'll cure you no matter what the cost."
- Dante Vale to Metz

"Sometimes looking at a problem from the opposite angle will allow to move forward."
- Dante Vale

"We have a guest. Get ready for a scuffle."
- Cherit to Lok Lambert and Sophie Casterwill

"I know how much you like disliking each other, but we need to get to the Titan before the bad guys do!"
- Lok Lambert to Sophie Casterwill and Zhalia Moon

"You have two options - a, turn tail and hope I don't send [King Basilisk] after you or b, the pedestal in the other room gets a lovely new statue."
- Zhalia Moon to DeFoe and his Suits
